title: SocioBench: Modeling Human Behavior in Sociological Surveys with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the differences in LLM accuracy when simulating human survey responses based on personas from different geographic regions (continents) such as Africa, Europe, North America, and Oceania.
Comparing the behavioral simulation accuracy of LLMs when role-playing as female versus male respondents across various sociological survey domains.
Assessing the disparities in model simulation accuracy when prompted with personas belonging to different age groups (e.g., 18-25 vs. 56-65 and 66+).
